<div class="card-body">
'''Trooper Davin Felth''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">トルーパー・デイヴィン・フェルス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーンにいるなら、「地元のいざこざ」と「ドロイドです！」をユーズド・インタラプトとして使用できる。フェルスのいる場所で「同士撃ち」を使用したなら、敵は自由に目標を選択することができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Trooper-Davin-Felth-PSA-89673868.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タンティヴィIVから逃亡したドロイドを捕獲するためタトゥイーンに派遣された。帝国軍のやり方に疑問を持っている模様。上官を背中から撃ったという噂がある。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Trooper Davin Felth.

'''Card text:'''
If he is on Tatooine, Local Trouble and Look Sir, Droids! may be used as Used Interrupts. If Friendly Fire is used at Felth's location, the opponent may freely choose the target.

'''Lore:'''
Dispatched to Tatooine to capture droids that fled Tantive IV. He has doubts about Imperial methods. There is a rumor that he shot his commander in the back.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore uses 模様 and 噂がある where English uses suspected and a claim that he shot his commander.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Trooper Davin Felth]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
